تلذوا (form I)
# تَلَذُّوا (talaḏḏū) /ta.lað.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
# تُلَذُّوا (tulaḏḏū) /tu.lað.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
